name: Bloons Survivor
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons Survivor is a free mobile game. Bloons Survivor is the story of a monkey, a grid, and many balloons. This is an incredible IO game where you can be the monkey on a mission to destroy every balloon! But this ain't your average monkey business, oh no. This monkey means business, and he's got the weapons to back it up. Starting with a simple set of darts, you'll need to use all your monkey might to pop those pesky balloons out of the sky. But as you progress through the game, you'll have the chance to upgrade your arsenal to include canon balls and throwing stars! With weapons like that, no balloon stands a chance against you. But that's not all, friends. This monkey is as fast as he is strong, and with each upgrade, you'll be able to increase his speed and damage value. You'll need every advantage you can get because this game is about surviving as long as possible. The balloons will keep coming, wave after wave, and it's up to you to keep throwing, slashing, and punching until they're all gone. Of course, it's not just about destroying balloons. You'll need to be strategic, too, planning your moves carefully to avoid getting hit by the balloons as they come at you from every direction. But with your quick reflexes and monkey-like agility, you can dodge and weave through the chaos like a pro. So come on, true believers, join the monkey on his epic journey through the grid, and show those balloons who's boss. Unlock new challenges and rewards, keeping you hooked for hours on end. It's an IO game, filled with excitement, action, and more monkey puns than you can shake a banana at.
